g.data-label: 009 D8 · the reproducibility promise, stated precisely repeating discovery under the recorded manifest and seed reproduces the same resolved program the exact program reproduces the same interaction log, outcome, and trace under a newer revision the program is the same regression input, but a changed outcome may be the intended evidence a bug was fixed — replay does not promise identical output across code changes a schema migration preserves old-program decoding or pins a runner; silently reinterpreting an old program is forbidden
